name: qa-realtime-protocols
description: Real-time protocol testing: 7 skills (websocket-tests, server-sent-events-tests, sse-load-test, grpc-streaming-tests, mqtt-tests, stomp-amqp-tests, webhook-replay-tests) and 1 agent (realtime-protocol-reviewer). Anchored on RFC 6455, WHATWG SSE, gRPC streaming, MQTT v5, and the Standard Webhooks signature scheme.
